title: Gateway Ingress Timeout & Backpressure
likely_root_cause: Downstream worker backlog or unhandled ingress burst causing socket timeouts and 504 responses
diagnostic_steps: Identify upstream microservice causing the slowest p99 latency response.
Verify ingress controller socket buffers and active HTTP/2 connections.
Check for DDoS or unusual traffic spikes targeting specific routes.
recommended_remediation: Apply rate limiting at API gateway on offending IP blocks or abusive API keys.
Increase gateway proxy read timeout if backend long-running processing is expected.
Route traffic away from degraded cluster zones to healthy replicas.
